features.name: suspend_members_and_interface_dispatch
features.scope: Bounded suspend interface/abstract signatures and final-class methods with real saved receivers, delayed resumption, default dispatch, exception identity, physical Continuation slots, JVM verification and logical Kotlin metadata.
restrictions: Private/generic/defaulted/extension/inheritable concrete members, object/companion forms and unsupported control-flow shapes remain bounded.
Custom parameter annotations on suspend declarations reject explicitly; existing value-class and suspension-state limits remain.
No complete coroutine-library, Android runtime, full-app or performance claim.
